disposition_reason: ICP-MS measurement of 17 toxic elements in eight prenatal vitamin products (six brands, one in three batches) bought in New York; Table 3 prints mean ± SD micrograms per recommended daily dose.

study.design: Retail survey of finished prenatal vitamins (tablets, gummies, gel caps)
study.market: National chain supermarkets and pharmacies, New York, NY, USA
study.method: About 400 mg microwave-digested with HNO3, H2O2 and HF; ICP-MS (NexION 350D, standard and KED modes) with internal standards
study.lod_text: Listed in supplementary Table 2 (not in the PDF)
study.qa: NIST 1577 liver CRM and spike recoveries (recoveries in supplementary Table 1, not in the PDF)
